questions.question: When Jacob bowed low as his brother Esau came with four hundred men, Esau ran to him and embraced him. True or false?
When Esau asked who the women and children with Jacob were, how did Jacob describe the children?

answers.text: God graciously gave them to him
God gave them as a reward for his work
God sent them to make peace with Esau

questions.question: When Esau offered to lead the way, what reason did Jacob give for not traveling with him?

answers.text: His children were frail and his herds were nursing
His servants were worn out from the long trip
His wives needed to rest for a few days first
